name: pie-chart
title: Pie chart
description: Parts of a whole as a pie, or a donut with innerRadius.

css.content:
/* Pie and donut chart. Shared base: chart.css. */
.chart-slice { stroke-linejoin: round; transition: stroke-width var(--fast) var(--ease); }

a11y: The chart is role=img with the required title as its name.
A visually hidden table lists every slice with its value and share.
One focusable stop per slice with a spoken label; Arrow keys move between them and Escape hides the tooltip.
The value tooltip opens on hover and on keyboard focus.
Slices differ by fill pattern as well as colour, and the legend lists each with its value and share.

props.name: title
props.description: Accessible name and table caption. Required.

props.name: data
props.description: Slices: `[{label: 'Search', value: 40}]`. Negative values count as 0.

props.name: innerRadius
props.description: Hole size as a fraction of the radius, from 0 (pie) to just under 1. 0.6 makes a donut. Default 0.

props.name: valueFormat
props.description: Format a value for the legend, tooltip and table.
